label: Bug fix
description: Reproduce, red test, minimal fix, regression and mutation validation.

assignments.lead: Implementation lead — reproduce, add a failing regression test, implement the minimal approved fix, run gates, and commit a focused change.
assignments.reviewer: Reviewer — independently inspect the reproduction, scope, and lead diff. Do not edit production code.
assignments.verifier: Verifier — independently run regression and mutation checks. Limit edits to tests or fixtures and commit separately.

required_evidence: Regression test fails red and passes green
Mutation or revert check proves the test bites
Repository-defined test, lint, and format gates
